content:
The **Deathclaw Wellington** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A slab of Deathclaw Meat which has been wrapped in dough and baked in a tin.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: |
| Boiled Water (2) Deathclaw Egg (2) Deathclaw Meat (2) Pepper (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Deathclaw Wellington | | Deathclaw Wellington (1) |

Due to missing the "cooked" keyword, the Deathclaw Wellington is not buffed by the Backwoodsman #6 Magazine.
